description: Schema for agent manifest entities that store declarative agent configurations with tool resource references. Tool resources are resolved at runtime based on execution context (user, machine, workspace).

agent-type.description: Discriminator for specialised agent-manifest variants. Set to "sub-agent-dispatcher" for dispatcher manifests.

tools.description: Tool entries used by sub-agent-dispatcher manifests in place of the manifest.template.tools path.

agentDefinitionTool.description: A named sub-agent that the dispatcher can instantiate.

definition.description: Inline agent definition. Mutually exclusive with manifest-reference.

manifest-reference.description: Entity reference to an existing agent-manifest entity. Mutually exclusive with definition.
